text: Your... Independent Witch Exam?
Yuzu
Why so sudden?
I'm coming along too?
Isn't Leia still tracking down the mastermind behind the phantom?
She always stumbles over her words when she has something to hide. I think there's something she's not telling me...
Alright, I'll go with you.
Ancient life magic hums through these woods. I grew up here, so I know every nook and cranny.

But the sacred relic I'm after, the Everlasting Mercury Lamp, rests inside a hidden sanctuary deep in the interior – no easy place to reach.//nThat's why you need to hold on tight to my hand so you don't get lost, got it?
player
Got it. Lead the way.
Fox
Starling
...How do you know these names?
Chipmunk
Chi-Gu... Too loud... Who's making all that noise...?
...That's right! Just waiting for our Witch of Justice to return!
A subtle exchange of glances passes among the three critters – or perhaps I'm just imagining things.
Awesome! With the Forest Guard backing us up, passing this exam will be a breeze, {var:player_nickname}!
Her steps grow light and buoyant, her whole demeanor brightening visibly.
Yet her hand remains tightly clasped in mine, as though she's afraid I might vanish into thin air.
We navigate a dense maze of trees, brave the nighttime fog, and slip past giant spiderwebs...
Chi-Gu... Dropping nuts... to mark the trail...
{var:player_nickname}... {var:player_nickname}... Wake up! Please wake up!!
Nnn... What time is it...? Did I sleep too long? Sorry for worrying you.
The sanctuary is just ahead. Keep holding my hand today, and the fatigue won't catch up to you!
Thanks for keeping my spirits up.
We've been holding hands non-stop lately, haven't we?
...Is there something you're not telling me?
Argh... Think nothing of it.
A-argh! I-it just shows how much I value your presence!
Her fingers tighten around mine, radiating a quiet warmth.
Eventually, we emerge before an ethereal lake.
Faint specks of light shimmer across its tranquil surface like a fallen sky.//nNear the shore stands an ancient stone tablet, inscribed with arcane runes.

Argh... This is written in witches' script.//nIt says this is the Lake of Oblivion. Only companions who share a true bond can summon the Bridge of Memories across its waters. The entrance to the sanctuary lies on the far shore.
Argh, we have to gaze into the lake together. If our shared memories ring true, the bridge will manifest.
Shall we... give it a try, {var:player_nickname}?
Step by step, we approach the edge and look down.
Our reflections ripple upon the surface as past moments spark to life like constellations –

From the day we met to the trust we now share,//nfrom our first team-up at Asaha High School to rescuing Piji at Datura,//nfrom the wild Halloween spectacle to this very journey into the woods... Unknowingly, we have built a long trail of memories together.
A translucent bridge woven from starlight slowly stretches from beneath our feet toward the lake's center.
Memories continue to unfold –
Yuzu in the Memories
Who's that crying her eyes out over there?
Th-that was definitely not me!!
I wonder what little Yuzu was like.
I want to see what your forest life was like.
Without waiting for a response, she tugs the trio over to the water's edge and gently taps the surface.
...That day! The morning we watched the sunrise from the high ridge!
Images of a young girl playing tag with her three animal companions flicker across the water.
Ah... Right... R-really...?
As she reminisces, the bridge of starlight rapidly extends, nearly reaching the opposite shore.
Argh... Right, duty comes first! Across we go!
We step onto the gleaming span of memory.//nThough breathtakingly beautiful, it trembles faintly beneath our feet.
As the far bank draws near, the entire bridge begins to shake violently!//nThe luminous path dims and flares like a dying flame.
Where... where was it again?!
I... I don't remember either!
Chi-Gu...
Before she can finish, the bridge crumbles beneath the trio, sending them plummeting toward the lake!
Emerald tendrils shoot out like lightning, coiling tightly around her three companions.//nBut the force of their fall yanks Yuzu off balance, dragging her down with them!
(Grab her hand!)
The moment my hand closes around hers, time seems to slow to a crawl.
The starling takes wing, the chipmunk clings to the fox's ears, and the fox grips Yuzu's magical vine – yet its bushy tail brushes the mirrorlike surface of the lake.
Ripples spread across the lake. Our frantic reflections melt away, replaced by scenes both intimate and unfamiliar –
A younger Yuzu stands at the edge of the forest, a small bindle slung over her shoulder.//nThe animals gather around her in tearful farewell as she waves goodbye and turns to leave.
Argh... That day. I promised I'd come back, but I never imagined witch training would take this long...
Wait... what's this?
After her departure, the vision shifts to an aging fox.
Though frail, it moves with quiet grace, climbing to the ridge at the forest's edge every day to gaze into the distance.
Until one day, it can no longer make the climb.//nWith great care, it passes the enchanted leaf worn on its chest to a young cub.
An elderly starling, wings too weary for flight, teaches a hatchling where the sweetest berries grow;//nan aged chipmunk shows a tiny kit the secret burrows where winter nuts are stashed...
This is...
With a sudden snap, Yuzu's magical vines give way, plunging us all into the lake.
Summoning the last of my strength, I drag Yuzu and her three companions out of the water. By the time I look back, the Bridge of Memories has vanished.
Drenched from head to toe, Yuzu sits motionless on the muddy shore. Droplets run from the ends of her hair, making it impossible to tell lake water from tears.
The three little critters shuffle over cautiously, their ears drooping as they avoid her gaze.//nThe fox nudges the back of her hand with its nose.
...We're so sorry.
We didn't mean to deceive you...
So... Ao-Ao and the others were already... Then you are...?
Chi-Gu
Chi-Gumi... was my great-great-great-grandmother...
Why... Why didn't you tell me...?
Mother told us it would break your heart if you ever came back and found out...
So we just wanted... wanted to give you peace of mind...
When our generation took up the mantle of the Forest Guard... we made a solemn vow...
Yuzu curls into a ball on the ground, her shoulders quivering uncontrollably.
Tears stream down her face.

I walk over and sit quietly beside her, gently rubbing her back.//nIn the face of time's cold cruelty, words feel painfully hollow. Perhaps simply staying by her side is the best comfort I can offer right now.
Night falls, and the critters sleep huddled together. Yuzu sits alone by the campfire, absentmindedly poking at the embers.
Are you holding up okay?

...I'm fine, haha...//nI saw plenty of life and death growing up in these woods. Every creature has its own lifespan, after all.//nAo-Ao and the others just lived full lives and returned to the embrace of the nature spirits...
It's not like I'm that... fr-fragile...
...I-I just wasn't prepared for it, that's all.//nThey were so full of life when I left...
She pulls her knees closer to her chest.
You don't have to put on a brave face around me.
...Argh.
...Argh. Thank you.
She briefly glances up at me before lowering her gaze to the flames again, a trace of uncertainty lingering in her eyes.
Tell me, {var:player_nickname}... are you afraid of being alone?
What makes you ask that?
...I grew up in these woods, and the animals were the only family I had.//nBut they all belonged to their own packs and flocks, while I belonged nowhere.
That was when I finally understood the hollow ache I felt each night, when the animals returned to their homes and I went to sleep alone.//nIt was loneliness.
If a witch is destined to be alone, then I resolved to be a proud, lonely Witch of Justice.
For the longest time, that was my absolute truth.
And what about now?
...After leaving the forest, I met Master, and that fortune teller.
Then came One Han City, where I found my classmates.
And now... I have you, {var:player_nickname}.
Finding out that Ao-Ao and the others were gone... it scared me more than I ever expected.//nJust thinking that everyone I care about might leave me one by one someday...
Witches are meant to be alone, and the path of justice is a lonely one. But... but I don't want to lose anyone else.
I'm not much of a Witch of Justice, am I...?
She buries her face in her knees.//nBehind her, the firelight casts a small, trembling shadow.
I think...
Maybe that isn't loneliness – it's independence.
It doesn't have to be one or the other.
...Argh?
You've always been brave and independent, steadfast in following the path you chose. That unwavering resolve is what makes you shine so brightly.
You can walk alone when you need to, but there's nothing wrong with enjoying the company of those who choose to walk beside you. Just follow your heart.
So I... don't have to be completely alone?
Exactly. No matter what time brings or takes away, as long as it concerns the two of us...
I will never leave your side.
Even if we part ways, our bond will never break.
(Squeeze her hand a little tighter)
Her body trembles slightly as the haze of tears in her eyes slowly clears.
{var:player_nickname}, if you'll stay with me, then I won't let anything take you away!
Yeah, I hear you.
Then I'm in your hands, Witch of Justice.
Just then, a familiar, irresistible wave of drowsiness washes over me once more.
Her voice follows me as I swiftly slip into darkness.
Once Yuzu is certain that {var:player_nickname} is sound asleep, the lighthearted expression fades from her face.
She takes {var:player_nickname}'s hand once more. A soft, restorative emerald light blooms in her palm and shines steadily through the night.
The next morning, fully rested, we approach our final destination by the lakeside.
Before us yawns a vast grotto sealed by magical wards, its entrance breathing an icy draft that keeps us on our guard.
You two... please be careful.
Chi-Gu... Nuts... keep them safe...
(Whispering) ...The forbidden grounds are super dangerous, but Yuzu is family.
(Tailing quietly) The Forest Guard... never leaves a comrade behind...
(Clutching nuts tight) Chi-Gu... We go together...
Emerging from the cave, we find a hidden realm unfolding before us.//nAt its heart stands an ancient altar, its weathered stone etched with faded runes.
...Stay close to me, {var:player_nickname}. Don't leave my side.
Visitors... What is it you seek in this place?
The light takes shape as a faint figure. Its voice is gentle, yet heavy with bone-deep weariness.
...Is that the guardian spirit here?
Argh, maybe... I don't sense any malice from it. Let's try talking to it.
Hello! I am Yuzu, a Life Witch! I'm searching for the legendary sacred relic, the Everlasting Mercury Lamp!
...The Everlasting Mercury Lamp. Child, do you truly know what it is?
It's a sacred relic capable of purging any curse! If I can just find it, I can –
Heh... I thought the exact same thing once... How tragic...
The figure shakes its head softly, sending ripples through the radiant light.
The Everlasting Mercury Lamp has never been a physical artifact, nor does it rest in any hidden corner of the world.
It is a tribute to a witch's true purpose – a magical flame kindled in the depths of her soul the moment she overcomes her trial and attains enlightenment.
It manifests only when a witch's purpose is purest and her resolve strongest.
What... It's not... a sacred relic...?
Her voice fades to a whisper.//nStunned, her grip on her staff slowly loosens, and her arm falls to her side.
(Muttering) How can that be...? I pored over so many books... I really thought that if I just found it, I could...
Yuzu...?
...Tell me, what does it take to ignite that kind of magical flame?
What drives your search for it?
Is it because of the troublesome curse festering inside your companion?
A curse?
Inside me?
A sharp, searing pain shoots through my palm. As if drawn to the altar, a wisp of dark miasma bursts from my skin and streaks toward the light at its center!
I'm fine, but she...
Darkness coils around the figure, consuming its gentle glow bit by bit as it crumples in agony.
A-are you alright?!
Child, listen closely... while my mind remains... I must warn you...
Long ago... I was a Life Witch, just like you.//nBut I fell to darkness and became an Evil Witch who terrorized these lands...
Evil Witch's True Heart
In the end, a great mentor defeated me, separating the last pure spark of the ideals I once held and sealing it within this sanctuary...
Now, the curse clinging to your companion is corrupting me... My dark side is awakening once more...
Before I break free, run... Seal this place again, and don't let me escape... Take your friend and go, quickly!
But what about you?! I can't just abandon you and run away!
Foolish child...
She convulses violently, struggling against the dark magic until –
(Voice twisting into something sinister) Ah... It's already too late...
The light is swallowed whole by darkness.//nFrom within it emerges a figure clad in tattered witch's robes.
Corrupted Heart
My adorable little junior, since you chose not to run, why don't I grant your wish myself?
Survive, and you pass.
A deluge of pitch-black magical spikes rains down on us!
Aegis of Life!!
(Gritting her teeth) ...Summoning Magic! Red Panda Squad!
Red Panda Squad
Three red pandas materialize at her call, forming a protective ring around us.
Tsk-tsk... Such feeble magic, such pitiful familiars...//nWhat kind of mentor turns a gifted Life Witch into a mess like this? What a tragic waste of potential!
Another barrage of dark energy surges forward –
Three tiny creatures hurl themselves into the fray!
The Guard always stands on the front line!
Chi-Gu... Not afraid... Together...
...Heh, more little fools offering themselves up for slaughter.
Black spikes whistle through the air, homing in on the critters!
They tremble, but not one of them backs down.
...Run!

Yuzu raises a barrier behind us to cover our retreat. We fight our way out of the altar chamber and duck into a narrow rock crevice.//n//nYuzu hurriedly tends to the injured animals while the corrupted witch prowls somewhere in the distance, her wicked laughter echoing as she searches for our hiding place.
Cough... Yuzu, what about your wounds...?
I'm fine... How are you holding up?
...I'll manage. Yuzu, will you tell me everything now?
What is this curse inside me?
You knew all along, didn't you?
...Yeah.
Back when we rescued Piji, you lent me your strength...
And on Halloween night, you took that blow from the phantom for me.
That was when the curse slipped into you.

I sensed a dark energy clinging to you that I couldn't purge, and then you started getting tired so easily... After digging through endless records, I had to accept the truth: it was the phantom's life-draining curse.
I found the ritual to break it in my grimoires... and the Mercury Lamp was the final missing piece.
So the exam was a cover story. You brought me here to save me.
The grimoire warned that the more the victim worries, the faster the curse consumes them.//nI was terrified of telling you... I was scared it would only make things worse...

Keeping you close was the only way I could channel my mana into you day and night, replenishing what the curse was draining away.//nI thought if I could just find the lamp before the curse weakened you any further...
But the lamp wasn't even a real relic... I failed to save you, and I put everyone in danger... I'm so sorry...
Don't blame yourself.
We'll figure this out together.
{var:player_nickname}...
But... I don't know what to do anymore...
Let's find your true purpose together!
Should we pull back first and regroup?
That witch said the lamp appears when a witch's true purpose shines brightest.
I know that purpose has been inside you all along. You just have to listen to your heart.
My true purpose is...
Found you!
Why make things so difficult, little witch?
All you have to do is drain the life from every creature in these woods –
And your little friend here will be up and running in no time.
What... What did you say...?
Life and death are two sides of the same coin. Granting life or inflicting death – both are exquisite expressions of life magic!
Start with those three little beasts in your arms. I can turn them into puppets for you, and they'll stay by your side forever. How does that sound?
Bramble Whip!!
Ooh, what a fiery temper. Too bad every time you say no, your friend suffers even more. Let's see how long you can hold out.
Don't listen to her. She has no intention of saving me.
She wants you to sacrifice innocent lives so you'll stray from your true purpose and never light the lamp.//nYuzu, the lamp is the one thing she truly fears!
Heh. Quite perceptive for someone on their last legs. Pity you figured it out too late.
Gah–!!
(Grit your teeth)
{var:player_nickname}! Stop!!
Every second you waste only prolongs this person's suffering.
Yuzu clutches her staff so tightly that her knuckles turn white, and a muffled sob escapes her.
...Don't listen to her. I can take it.
Yuzu, think back! Why did you want to become a witch in the first place? What did you truly wish for –
Ugh... My true... purpose...
I became a witch because I wanted to...
You've always been brave and independent, steadfast in following the path you chose. That unwavering resolve is what makes you shine so brightly.
Yuzu Training in One Han City
To protect the smiles of the innocent... I will make any sacrifice!
Yuzu Just Starting to Learn Magic
Don't you hurt my friends! Red pandas are living, breathing creatures chosen by magic, just like me!
Yuzu Seeing Magic for the First Time
My true purpose... is to protect.
Life is nature's most precious gift. Strong or weak, every soul has the right to live.
That's the Yuzu I know!
Stubborn little fools! Since you're both so eager to throw your lives away – you can rot here together!
(Straining with all her might to maintain the barrier) ...Ugh...

{var:player_nickname}... The day I resolved to become the Witch of Justice, a mysterious spell took root in my heart like a seed. I never understood its purpose... until now. The moment my true flame ignited, the spell's true nature finally became clear.
It's a... contract spell – one that will bind our fates together forever. We'll share every joy and hardship... in life and in death. Are you... willing?
I am.
(Take her hand)
Y-you silly thing... You didn't even hesitate...
...Thank you.
Die–!
Black spikes come hurtling toward us!
I close my eyes –
yet nothing pierces through.
A warm, radiant light pours from Yuzu's staff, holding the onslaught at bay.
What is this...?!
A tiny flame sputters to life at Yuzu's chest, then surges into a brilliant blaze.
Th-this is...!! The Everlasting Mercury Lamp?! But your heart wavered!!
My heart did waver. I was so terrified of losing {var:player_nickname} that I almost forgot who I was.
A colossal torrent of dark miasma slams into us with devastating force!
From this day forth, {var:player_nickname} shall be sheltered under the wings of my justice. We shall honor, cherish, and stand by one another –
Protecting the people who matter to me is what justice means too.
Countless verdant vines burst from the earth, wrapping around Yuzu and me in a gentle embrace.
The shadowy figure rapidly weakens, its form collapsing into a writhing mass of dark flames –
I won't let you have your way!
Argh-argh!!!
The red pandas leap forward, tackling the mass of dark flames and pinning it down with all their might!
Let go... Let go of me!!
Argh! Never underestimate red pandas! They've got sharp claws and fierce spirits!
Now, by the power of the oath that binds {var:player_nickname} and me – be cleansed, corrupted heart of the Evil Witch!!
Enveloped in radiant light and green vines, the dark flames let out one final, piercing shriek before scattering into nothingness.
...Thank you, little witch.
A gentle wisp of light rises from where the dark flames dissolved. It settles briefly on Yuzu's shoulder before drifting into the sky.
The path of the heart hinges on a single thought. Whether life magic serves light or darkness depends entirely on the soul that wields it.
May the true purpose in your hearts... never fade.
Morning light breaks into the sanctuary.//nThe curse has lifted, and my body feels lighter than ever.
Yuzu drops to her knees and gently gathers the wounded animals close, wrapping them in soothing healing light.
Chi-Gu... Did we win...?
Tears stream down her cheeks, yet her lips curve into a joyful smile.
So, um... {var:player_nickname}... you don't mind that oath we just made, right?
Not a single regret.
I'm lucky to be bound to you.
Argh-Argh
Argh! Argh!
Arrrrgh
Arrrrgh... Best wishes...
!! Wh-what?! Stop talking, all of you–!!
Sunlight pours in, bathing everyone in a warm glow. With a new bond and an enduring vow, a new chapter begins.
Things are too unpredictable right now, and we need to conserve our strength. Let's fall back and regroup!
...Okay.
That day, we failed to break the curse.
Gathering the last of her magic, Yuzu managed to suppress the corrupted witch's heart and seal it away once more before leading me and the animals out of the sanctuary.
Once we left the magic-infused forest, the curse's grip on me actually weakened quite a bit.
Since returning to One Han City, Yuzu has locked herself away in Datura's alchemy room.
Even so, Yuzu is determined to find a cure.
Formula 27... Needs one more hour to brew...
Take a break. You've been up for three nights straight.
Before she can finish, her head drops into a pile of herbs.
Yuzu!
Mmm... {var:player_nickname}... later... try roasting it with some sauropus...
You haven't slept in three days. Get some rest first.
But... the curse...
Look at me, I'm doing just fine. Besides –
Maybe a potion the Witch of Justice can't brew alone can be completed when she works together with her partner.
...You're gonna help me make the medicine?
Of course. How long were you planning to keep doing this all by yourself?
But fair warning – I'm not so sure I trust your cooking-style alchemy with all the "roasting" and "frying."
Her voice trails off as her head comes to rest on my shoulder, her breathing settling into a slow, peaceful rhythm.
Outside the window, the three red pandas and the young Forest Guard sneak inside, laden with fresh herbs from the enchanted woods.
We're here –
Argh-argh!
Crash! In their eagerness, the animals end up causing chaos yet again.
(Jolting awake) Argh!! My Formula 27!!
...See? What did I tell you?
The curse lingers, and a cure remains elusive.
But this time, Yuzu won't have to face it alone.
Phew... You're finally awake.//nIt's my fault... I pushed us way too hard these past few days.
Let's do it.
Argh... I'm not used to having humans around... Perhaps... perhaps I'll just make you an exception...
Finally, the vision comes to rest on three simple earthen mounds.//nBefore them stand three young creatures wearing enchanted leaves.
Then I met Master. She told me that witches are fated to walk their paths alone.
It requires the unyielding strength of a witch's true purpose. Countless witches have spent entire lifetimes failing to spark even a flicker.
...The lingering curse... of the Evil Witch's ghost... The altar's power has awakened it...
An emerald barrier manages to hold off the initial wave, but cracks immediately spread across its surface.
Thorny vines burst from the ground, lashing through the dark fog and forcing the witch half a step back. She merely scoffs.
Code of the Witch of Justice: A Righteous Heart May Waver, but Never Yield!
Th-that's right! Thanks to my stellar performance in capturing that phantom, I asked Master for permission to take the Independent Witch Exam!
Now you and I are heading to the woods where I grew up to locate a legendary sacred r-relic... Ouch, bit my tongue...
Argh...! In short, the exam protocol allows one trusted partner of justice to assist!//nYou're my most reliable companion, so your presence is mandatory...
Argh! Fantastic! We leave right away!
Halt! Forest Guard! Who dares trespass on these grounds?!
Chirp-chirp! The green-haired witch! Just like in the stories!
...Ao-Ao! Muk-Chirp! I can't believe it's you!

Argh, you were my best friends when I was little!//nThose enchanted leaves you're wearing were my parting gift – they let you speak human languages to scare off poachers, remember?//nDon't you recognize me?
...Arf! Yuzu, you've returned!//nTh-the human beside you threw me off, that's all!
Chi-Gumi! You're all here!
O-of course! We're the Forest Guard! We guard these woods every single day!
Onward! Let's keep moving!
Leave it to me! I can spot the exit from above!
Arf, time for a diversion! I'll draw the spiders away – press ahead while you can!

Working in seamless harmony with the Forest Guard,//n//nwe clear one hazard after another, closing in on our destination.//n//nYet the trek exacts a heavy toll on me, leaving me more exhausted with every passing day.
A-argh! As if I'd keep secrets from you! S-stop overthinking things...
Arf! Look at the water – it's appearing!
D-dummy! Who told you to jump in front of me like that?! I could've handled it on my own...
Wh-when did I ever say something so embarrassing...?!
Argh... Enough of those! Let's skip to something else!
Argh... You really don't give up, do you? Fine.
Ao-Ao! Muk-Chirp! Chi-Gumi! Over here! It's the Forest Guard's turn! Our memories will easily carry the bridge the rest of the way!
Come on, don't be shy! It's been so long – let's relive those days together!
Look! Back then, Ao-Ao couldn't even outrun me!
Th-that's enough! The bridge is solid!//n...Let's hurry across – {var:player_nickname} looks completely spent!
Argh! The bridge is fading! Quick, Ao-Ao, focus on the details!//nUm... Remember how sweet those wild berries tasted that morning? And where did we go after our race –
How could you forget?! Those were our most precious –
Hold on! Vines of the Forest Guardian!
{var:player_nickname}? Feeling tired again?
Get some rest and save your strength... Tomorrow... tomorrow we'll reach the sanctuary and claim the sacred relic! Victory will be ours in no time!
You can do this, Yuzu! We believe in you!
...Mm! Thank you, everyone!
I-it's nothing! I'm just...
{var:player_nickname}! Are you okay?!
H-how could this happen?!
You want to light the Everlasting Mercury Lamp for your friend, don't you? Let's test your strength first and see if you're up to the mark!
Argh-Argh! Argh! Argh! Arrrrgh–
Arf!! Forest Guard, charge!!
Arf! Don't say such stupid things!
Spirits of nature, heed my call! Seal this evil away!
Oh? Now this is somewhat amusing.
Dark fog seals off the narrow exit in an instant! Miasma coils tightly around my limbs, bringing on a heavy, suffocating wave of exhaustion that drags my consciousness down into the abyss.
Didn't your mentor teach you anything? Life magic isn't just about healing – it can take life away, too.
That's monstrous! Life magic exists to protect others! I'd rather die than use magic like that!
Or will you just stand there and watch the person who matters most to you wither away before your eyes... leaving you all alone again, just as you feared?
In your dreams! I'll find another way! Hang in there, {var:player_nickname} –
Well? Made up your mind?
I will never, EVER allow vile villains to just casually steal away everyone's precious lives!
But mark my words – I am the Witch of Justice! I may cry, I may be afraid, and I may stumble, but my resolve to protect others will NEVER be broken by a monster like you!
Curse you... CURSE YOU!! Even so, you're bruised and battered! You won't hold out much longer! I'll corrupt that precious heart of yours – and your soul along with it!
Y-you're insane! You're throwing away your mana for nothing!
...Argh! We won! You all did amazing!
We're bound for life now! It's way too late for regrets!
D-dummy! Don't say things like that in front of everyone, argh-ghhh!!
Argh-argh! We heard everything!
...?//nWait, I can actually understand the red pandas now? Is this because of the contract spell?
Argh! Now the captain doesn't have to hide her secrets anymore!
No! I have to find a cure no matter... what...
Argh-argh! That's called innovation! Progress always comes through trial and error –
Over the next few days, we press deeper into the forest.
Aoey
I'm Aoey. Ao-Ao was my mother.
Chirpy
I'm Chirpy. Muk-Chirp was my great-grandmother.
From what we heard earlier, it sounds like Ao-Ao, Muk-Chirp, and Chi-Gumi all lived full, happy lives.
Aoey, Chirpy, Chi-Gu – this is far enough. Wait for us here while we retrieve the relic.
Aoey, Chirpy, and Chi-Gu watch as Yuzu and {var:player_nickname} step into the grotto.
Suspended above the altar is a globe of soft light, pulsing gently like a slow, steady breath.
Aoey! What are you doing here?! Get out of here –

Aoey braces herself and bears the brunt of the first dark blast.//nChirpy darts through the barrage, knocking aside the incoming spikes.//nChi-Gu throws its tiny arms wide to shield its wounded friends.

The second assault strikes –//nAoey is hurled against the stone wall and slides limply to the ground.//nDark flames singe Chirpy's wing, sending her crashing down.//nChi-Gu is sent tumbling by the shockwave, but scrambles back to its feet and holds the line.

Spirits of Southern Winds, when you descend, weave the bond of trust from three sacred relics – the Rootless Sauropus, the Red Lotus Flame of Sumeru, and the Everlasting Mercury Lamp – and bind {var:player_nickname} and me together.
